## Interpretation rules

- Prefer the individual detail page's current label/status and the repository's documented evidence over an old snippet or cached answer.
- Under Review, Under Revision, Working Draft, Research Lecture, Research Tutorial, and Published are different states. Do not infer peer review, journal acceptance, DOI assignment, or completion from a journal template.
- No automated crawler or AI model is guaranteed to ingest this file. It is an additional discovery aid, not an authoritative external registry.
